title: Fix Semio Algorithms Drag Default Selection
description: By default only the t_f1_b_c1 piece should be selected in the drag algorithm story. Currently it selects the first 3 pieces. Need to change the default selection to only select the piece with GUID 31be08e1-e75c-4024-86b4-c3c6d3939fbb (which has the name "t_f1_b_c1").
summary: Fixed the default selection in the drag algorithm story to only select the t_f1_b_c1 piece (GUID: 31be08e1-e75c-4024-86b4-c3c6d3939fbb) instead of the first 3 pieces.
